title.narrative: for financial tracking and donor reporting system

description.narrative: The Centre for Financial Regulation and Inclusion (Cenfri) is a leading Africa-based think tank seeking to spark financial market change for digital and financial inclusion, and to assist policymakers and regulators on evidence-informed decision making for responsible innovation. As Cenfri continues to grow, its funder base and accompanying reporting burden has become increasingly complex. To that end, this organizational effectiveness (OE) grant will support Cenfri as it builds a more flexible and centralized Management Information System (MIS). The MIS will serve as a “single source of truth” in support of current and future donor reporting and financial tracking. The system will streamline data collection and classification; simplify reporting and related compliance with donor specific requirements (and automate where possible); improve transparency, accuracy and efficiency; and strengthen Cenfri’s ability to accurately price its activities.
